I came across this beautiful Nandi Bull Statue near Plaza Cinema in Dadar East. It’s a striking and culturally symbolic statue that represents strength, patience, and devotion in Indian mythology. The statue is beautifully crafted and placed right in the middle of a bustling area, making it a peaceful yet eye-catching spot.

It adds a unique charm to the area and is perfect for a quick photo stop while exploring Dadar. The surrounding area is lively with theatres, local shops, and classic Mumbai street vibes. A great example of tradition blending with city life.

Tip: Visit in the evening when the traffic calms down a bit, and the lighting makes the statue look even more majestic.

featured_reviews.name: Nishad Shahasane
featured_reviews.review_text:
Plaza Cinema is one of Mumbai’s oldest and most famous movie halls, located in the heart of Dadar, just a 5-minute walk from Dadar Station and near Shivsena Bhavan.

It’s a single-screen theatre with around 800 seats and a classic, nostalgic charm. The screen is big, the sound is good, and the hall is clean. Facilities include clean washrooms, drinking water, and parking for cars and bikes (no roadside parking).

Snacks are slightly expensive but easily available. The place is usually crowded, which adds to its lively atmosphere. There is a bus stop nearby named "Plaza" from where you can find BEST buses to various locations across Mumbai.

Overall, Plaza Cinema offers a good, old-school movie experience at affordable prices — a must-visit for anyone who loves vintage theatres.

featured_reviews.name: Rajat Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
On a rainy Sunday, I visited Nakshatra Mall in Dadar West and the experience was quite pleasant. Located conveniently near Shivaji Park, the mall is easy to reach and offers a cozy escape from the rains. Though not as large as some of the newer malls in the city, Nakshatra Mall has its own charm with a compact layout and a good mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment options.

The mall houses a variety of retail outlets, including popular apparel and lifestyle stores, making it a convenient spot for casual shopping. It also has a few branded showrooms where one can find both everyday wear and festive collections. What I particularly liked was that the mall wasn’t overcrowded, which made the shopping experience more comfortable, especially on a rainy day when people usually prefer indoor activities.

The food court and small eateries provide enough options for a quick bite, from snacks to proper meals. The seating area was neat, and the service was reasonably quick. The cinema hall inside the mall is another highlight, offering a good option to catch a movie while spending time indoors.

Overall, Nakshatra Mall may not be very big, but it is well-maintained, convenient, and a good weekend hangout spot.

featured_reviews.review_text:
My visit to INOX Neelyog in Ghatkopar East was a bit of a mixed experience. While the theatre itself is okay, it feels like a bit of a deserted venue. The mall it’s located in is quite old, and despite being owned by PVR-INOX, the place feels stuck in time, lacking the modern amenities you’d expect from their brand. It doesn’t have the same fresh, updated atmosphere as other PVR-INOX theatres.

Its proximity to the Ghatkopar Railway Station makes it a convenient choice for moviegoers relying on public transport.

The seating was decent, but there was nothing exceptional about it. The overall maintenance seemed lacking, and the place just felt a bit neglected. The staff were polite, but the overall service felt a bit lackluster, especially when compared to other PVR-INOX theatres. The staff seemed understaffed, and there were minor delays in service, particularly at the concession stand. As for maintenance, it was evident that the theatre could use some attention. The cleanliness in the common areas and washrooms was below par, and the seats, though functional, showed signs of wear and tear.

The ticket prices were reasonable, but when compared to other PVR-INOX theatres, this one doesn’t justify the price for the experience it offers. Snacks were also the standard fare, but the portions were smaller, and they didn’t feel as fresh.

In summary, while it wasn’t a terrible experience, it felt more like a theatre stuck in the past, lacking the vibrant and well-maintained vibe you’d expect from a PVR-INOX property. It’s good if you're in the area, but I wouldn’t go out of my way for it.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this to warn everyone about the severe lack of safety and basic humanity at Roxy Cinema. Yesterday, my mother attended the 10 PM show of 'Dhabkaaro'. As the crowd was exiting the lift, a heavy ceiling tile suddenly collapsed and fell onto the people below. Two people were injured badly and bleeding, and heavy tile pieces hit my mother's head.
While accidents can happen, the theatre staff's reaction was absolutely disgusting. They were completely uncooperative. Nobody stepped forward to offer basic first aid, medical support, or even a glass of water to the bleeding and injured patrons. We had to literally shout and threaten to call the police just to get them to act, and even then, they helped completely half-heartedly.
We are now dealing with significant medical expenses, and the theatre management hasn't even had the decency to offer a simple apology. They clearly do not care about the safety or lives of their customers. Avoid this theatre at all costs unless you want to put your life at risk.

Many visitors praise the sound quality and screen clarity, noting that it provides a decent viewing experience despite being an older venue.
The seating is frequently criticized for being torn, uncomfortable, or poorly maintained, with some reviewers noting a lack of cleanliness in the auditorium.
Management issues are a common theme in complaints, specifically regarding long exit processes, unhelpful staff, and unsanitary restroom conditions.
The food court offers classic cinema snacks like popcorn and samosas, though some guests find the pricing to be high relative to the theater's overall quality.
Overall, it is a suitable choice

Natraj Cinema, a name synonymous with cinematic entertainment, has been a cultural cornerstone in the heart of the city for decades. Natraj Cinema has upheld this tradition, offering not just movies but an experience that transcends the silver screen.

Natraj Cinema boasts state-of-the-art facilities, including cutting-edge sound systems and high-definition screens, ensuring a top-notch audio-visual experience for its patrons. The cinema's comfortable seating and inviting ambiance create a welcoming atmosphere, making every visit a memorable one.

What sets Natraj Cinema apart is its diverse selection of films. From the latest blockbusters to critically acclaimed independent movies and regional gems, the cinema caters to a wide audience, embracing varied tastes and preferences. Families flock to Natraj Cinema for its family-friendly screenings, creating cherished memories together.

Moreover, Natraj Cinema stands as a cultural beacon, hosting film festivals, premieres, and special events that celebrate the art of cinema. It serves as a platform for budding filmmakers, providing a space where creativity and innovation are nurtured and appreciated.

Beyond its cinematic offerings, Natraj Cinema engages with the community, organizing charity events, fundraisers, and awareness campaigns. The cinema believes in giving back to the society it serves, making a positive impact beyond the realm of entertainment.

In essence, Natraj Cinema is not merely a movie theater; it is a cherished institution that weaves stories, emotions, and togetherness into the fabric of the community. It continues to illuminate the silver screen, bringing joy and entertainment to generations, ensuring that the magic of cinema lives on, one screening at a time.

featured_reviews.name: Venkat Krishnan
featured_reviews.review_text: I saw it from outside and came to know what would be inside. I was a resident of Chembur from 1960 to 1991. I still remember, during the 60s, it was pride of Chembur as it was the only air conditioned  theatre in the area and going there to watch any movie with family and friends was a great pleasure for all. AC was very powerful, seats very comfortable, picture and sound quality excellent, canteen used to serve tasty samosas, snacks and beverages at reasonable prices. Management was talking pains to maintain the ambience and decor. But over the period, due to poor management, improper maintenance, the quality deteriorated gradually and it has come to the present stage. Added to all these, competition from multiplexes has caused further damage. Most surprising is still it continues to run against all odds is something great. I doubt will there be any scope for improvement. The best option will be to sell the land to some potential builder who can build Shopping mall or residential tower, as the place is strategically located (very close to railway station and bus stop ). Rest is left to God.

featured_reviews.name: Dev Sai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fun Cinemas, located on the 4th floor of K Star Mall in Chembur, offers a standard movie-going experience with some notable positives and areas that could use improvement. One of the standout aspects of this theatre is its diverse language screenings, including Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu, Hindi, and English. This makes it a great option for regional movie lovers in Mumbai who want to catch films in their native language.

The sound and visual quality are commendable, with Dolby Atmos enhancing the audio experience and the screen clarity being satisfactory. These technical aspects ensure that the core movie-watching experience is enjoyable. The theatre is also conveniently located near Diamond Garden and is close to Ghatala railway station, making it easily accessible for locals and commuters.

However, the theatre's location in an old and mostly abandoned mall detracts significantly from the overall experience. The mall feels deserted, especially at night, which creates an eerie and isolated atmosphere. Inside, the seating, although slightly repaired and improved, is still average, with some chairs showing signs of wear and tear. The maintenance of the premises is also below par, with cleanliness in common areas needing much more attention.

The food and beverage options are decent, with the nachos and cool drinks standing out as personal favorites. However, like most multiplexes in Mumbai, the prices are high, which doesn’t always align with the quality or portion sizes. There have also been occasional complaints about stale food, which is disappointing.

In conclusion, Fun Cinemas in K Star Mall is a decent choice if you’re looking to watch movies in regional languages or live nearby. However, the outdated ambiance, maintenance issues, and high prices make it a less appealing option compared to other multiplexes in the city.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Aher
featured_reviews.review_text:
🎬 INOX IMAX – R City Mall, Ghatkopar | Honest IMAX Experience Review

I recently watched an IMAX screening at INOX IMAX R City Mall, and here’s a clear, no-nonsense review based on the actual experience.

Overall Experience: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5)

What Works Well:
•	IMAX scale & immersion: The auditorium delivers the signature IMAX feel with a massive screen and powerful surround sound, making it a good choice for big-budget, visually heavy films.
•	Comfortable environment: The hall is clean, well-maintained, and acoustics are solid, especially for action and background scores.
•	Location advantage: Being inside R City Mall makes it convenient with ample food and parking options.

What Could Be Better:
•	Projection quality (3D): While watching Avatar: Fire and Ash in 3D, the visuals felt noticeably blurred. A laser IMAX projection would have significantly improved sharpness, brightness, and depth.
•	Seats: The seating is decent but not premium. For long IMAX movies, better cushioning and ergonomics would enhance comfort.
•	3D clarity: Fast-moving scenes lacked crispness, which slightly broke immersion—something you don’t expect from an IMAX-branded screen.

Final Verdict:
INOX IMAX R City Mall is good for IMAX movies, especially if you value screen size and sound, but it falls short of a true next-gen IMAX experience due to the non-laser projection and average seating. Upgrade to laser projection and better seats, and this could easily become one of Mumbai’s top IMAX destinations.

Recommended for: Big action / spectacle films
Not ideal for: Viewers sensitive to 3D blur or expecting laser-sharp visuals
